d: Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership
q: Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required.
Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning).
Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases.
Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems.
Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records.
Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems.
Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation.
Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar).
Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively.
r: Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline.
Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale.
Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them.
Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring.
Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour.
Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them.
Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling.
Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked.
Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost.
Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones.
Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins.
Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation

d: The Fleet Sales Executive is responsible for generating and managing fleet sales business by acquiring new customers and maintaining strong relationships with existing corporate, government, rental, and leasing clients. The role focuses on achieving assigned sales targets, delivering excellent customer service, and supporting the execution of the company’s fleet sales strategy through effective account management and sales execution.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
Automotive or fleet sales certifications are an advantage.
Minimum 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in automotive fleet, leasing, or corporate sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing corporate accounts.
Experience in tender handling, contract negotiation, and key account management is preferred.
r: Identify, prospect, and develop new fleet sales opportunities within corporate, government, rental, and institutional segments.
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned fleet sales targets and market share objectives.
Conduct client meetings, presentations, and needs assessments to understand customer fleet requirements.
Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of fleet customers, ensuring long-term relationships and repeat business.
Act as the primary point of contact for fleet customers throughout the sales lifecycle.
Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, including vehicles, financing, maintenance, and value-added services.
Prepare and present fleet proposals, quotations, and pricing structures aligned with customer needs and company policies.
Advise customers on vehicle selection, fleet optimization, total cost of ownership (TCO), and lifecycle management.
Negotiate commercial terms and contracts within approved authority levels.
Coordinate vehicle orders, specifications, production schedules, and delivery timelines with internal sales support, logistics, and aftersales teams.
Monitor order progress and ensure timely vehicle delivery, registration, and handover.
Ensure accurate completion of sales contracts, documentation, and compliance requirements.
Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and order data in CRM and sales systems.
Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and pipeline updates for management review.
Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback within the fleet segment.
Ensure compliance with company sales policies, pricing guidelines, and ethical standards.
Adhere to legal, financial, and regulatory requirements related to fleet sales and contracts.
Support internal audits, reporting requirements, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

d: Would you like to be part of the most international company in the world? A company operating in more than 220 countries worldwide and has been pioneering cross-border express shipping since 1969. Would you like to be part of a business that connects people across the globe and want to make a difference? Then waste no time and join our amazing team at DHL Group. DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the Group's air, ocean, and road freight specialist. We offer standardized transport as well as highly specialized end-to-end solutions to customers in a wide range of industries globally.
Who ever said ‘‘the sky is the limit’’ never spoke to you! Because for you it’s the beginning DHL Global Forwarding has an opening for IP Operations Specialist in Doha, Qatar.
Join us in connecting people and improving lives!
In this IP Operations Specialist position
Own daily coordination of customs clearance and local delivery activities for allocated files, ensuring readiness before cargo arrival and close follow-up until final delivery.
Coordinate with customs brokers and government liaison resources on declarations, inspections, temporary imports or exports, permits, exemptions, approvals, and cargo release requirements.
Coordinate delivery order collection and surrender requirements with shipping lines and airlines, including required payments, guarantees, deposits, authorizations, and document handover.
Arrange road transportation and suitable equipment based on cargo dimensions, weight, handling method, site constraints, and delivery schedule.

For heavy, oversized, or special cargo, coordinate route and site requirements, transport permits, escorts, lifting interfaces, method statements, risk assessments, and HSE requirements with the responsible parties.
Confirm delivery appointments, site access, receiving resources, offloading readiness, and proof-of-delivery requirements before dispatch.
Monitor vehicles and cargo during execution, manage exceptions, and maintain clear communication with customers, transporters, customs brokers, terminals, warehouses, and internal stakeholders.
Validate supplier invoices and operational costs against agreed rates and services; ensure costs are accrued and supporting documents are available for billing and file closure.
Act as the customer’s operational point of contact for allocated shipments or project scopes.
Provide timely status reports covering routing, documentation, arrival, clearance, transportation, delivery, exceptions, and recovery actions.
Handle customer enquiries, conduct operational meetings or site visits when required, and translate customer requirements into practical execution plans.
Coordinate closely with expediting, inspection, procurement, shipping, warehouse, and site personnel to maintain alignment with project schedules.
Arrange AFR and OFR bookings and coordinate with origins, destinations, carriers, agents, and vendors to protect committed delivery dates.
Issue and review shipment reports, delivery records, incident updates, and operational documentation.
Execute operations in line with DHL procedures, customer SOPs, legal requirements, trade compliance, HSE standards, and Industrial Projects operating standards.

Identify operational risks early and implement or coordinate mitigation actions related to documentation, customs, permits, capacity, route, site, cargo handling, demurrage, detention, storage, and waiting time.
Monitor file profitability, cost accuracy, billing completeness, unbilled items, and potential cost leakage; escalate adverse variances and support corrective actions.
Maintain complete and auditable shipment files, including approvals, quotations, vendor instructions, permits, declarations, proof of delivery, invoices, and exception records.
Resolve day-to-day operational issues, report significant events and exceptions to management, and support continuous improvement of local operating practices.
Support contingency and recovery planning for urgent, delayed, damaged, rejected, or otherwise exceptional shipments.

Build and manage effective relationships with customers, internal departments, customs brokers, government liaison resources, shipping lines, airlines, terminals, warehouses, transporters, equipment providers, and site teams.
Coordinate with Finance on payments, duty or tax outlays where approved, vendor invoices, accruals, customer billing, and file closure.
Monitor service-provider performance against agreed requirements and initiate or support improvement actions when performance falls short.
Escalate issues with concise facts, operational impact, cost exposure, required decisions, and proposed next steps.
Share operational knowledge and provide practical guidance to colleagues on local clearance, transport, documentation, and execution requirements.
q: Experience in freight forwarding, project logistics, customs clearance coordination, and local transportation operations Qatar
Good working knowledge of AFR and OFR operations, import and export documentation, delivery order processes, customs declarations, inspections, permits, and cargo release follow-up.
Practical understanding of standard, containerized, breakbulk, heavy, and oversized cargo movements, including transport equipment and site-delivery coordination.
Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, deadlines, and operational exceptions with strong ownership and attention to detail.
Good commercial awareness, including cost control, accruals, billing readiness, file profitability, and avoidance of demurrage, detention, storage, and waiting-time exposure.
Good communication, analytical, administrative, and problem-solving skills, with confidence in dealing with customers and external service providers.
Good knowledge of customer-service processes, forwarding systems, shipment reporting, Microsoft Office, and professional email communication.
Ability to work independently in the field and office, while escalating material risks and decisions appropriately.
Good command of English, verbal and written; Arabic is an advantage.
x: Opportunities in a global company where you can contribute your ideas and skills to move towards our shared goals.
We are part of Deutsche Post DHL, the world’s leading logistics provider with operations in over 220 countries. Visit our career site on the web at https://www.logistics.dhl/us-en/home/careers.html

d: We are seeking an analytical, strategic, and highly structured Quality Analyst to coordinate and manage quality assurance frameworks, operational auditing pipelines, and process compliance portfolios from planning through completion at M.E CONSULTING®. This role will work closely with cross-functional operations teams, project managers, quality auditors, systems administrators, and organizational stakeholders to ensure daily operational workflows, quality testing benchmarks, and performance evaluation systems are delivered according to agreed schedules, structural blueprints, strict regional compliance codes, and company objectives.
q: Diploma or Degree in Quality Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related applied technical or commercial discipline.
Experience in quality analysis , operational or software auditing execution, defect troubleshooting, process coordination, or related quality advisory pipelines.
Good understanding of structural quality architecture , root-cause defect analysis, quality calibration models, and cross-functional team coordination.

Familiarity with enterprise database software , specialized quality tracking and CRM platforms (e.g., Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce), SQL or BI reporting tools, organizational suites (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace), and modern spreadsheet engines.
Strong project coordination , analytical communication, relationship alignment, and stakeholder management skills under strict operational pressure.
Good analytical and systematic troubleshooting abilities with extreme attention to audit accuracy, compliance guidelines, and performance metrics.
Able to manage multiple quality evaluation tracks simultaneously and execute analytical tasks according to tight, agreed project timelines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel) , business intelligence visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and standard project tracking frameworks.
Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams , external auditors, operational managers, or cross-functional team leads will be an advantage.
r: Manage and coordinate quality assurance projects , operational compliance assessments, and end-to-end quality auditing workflows from initial planning through execution.
Develop quality evaluation logic layouts , baseline performance milestones, cross-departmental testing matrices, and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) blueprints.
Coordinate closely with management , operations leads, training specialists, systems administrators, and back-office operational support teams.
Monitor project progress , digital quality audit inventories, operational improvement budgets, tracking timelines, and key structural quality deliverables.
Coordinate with corporate clients , systems technicians, external audit partners, independent vendors, and key operational stakeholders to maintain absolute alignment.
Review documentation requirements , technical specification data sheets, process diagnostic logs, audit layout files, and related compliance validation files.
Support procurement and coordination of specialized quality monitoring assets, remote auditing software tools, analytics visualization platforms, and related reporting infrastructure.
Monitor system and process updates , quality dashboard testing, digital reporting interface configuration, and formal quality assurance handover activities.
Identify operational risks , quality performance variances, workflow bottlenecks, and potential compliance delays and coordinate appropriate corrective solutions.
Conduct quality review meetings and prepare comprehensive execution summaries, audit validation schedules, defect and compliance KPIs, and management reporting dashboards.

Ensure quality auditing and on-site operational activities are carried out in accordance with relevant corporate laws, Bahrain Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) compliance codes, and international quality certifications (e.g., ISO standards).
Maintain accurate quality documentation , audit scoring registry logs, corrective action records, and tracking files throughout the operational lifecycle.
Support improvements to operational delivery pipelines , multi-disciplinary team calibration, and continuous quality optimization workflows.
